subject: Request to substitute a PVC alternate in lieu of the cast-iron roof drain leader

messages.text: We're proposing a PVC alternate in lieu of the cast-iron roof drain leader specified in Section 22 14 00 and want sign-off before we order material. No rush -- please take a look whenever it's convenient. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order. This RFI is unrelated to the pending material cost-escalation claim submitted separately.

The submittal for a PVC alternate in lieu of the cast-iron roof drain leader specified in Section 22 14 00 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. No impact to the plumbing fixture budget is anticipated.
